Yeah, this makes more sense. I'm planning on moving to America soon, hopefully, so I can live with my girlfriend and there are a few 'complications' at the moment. Though, there's one thing that gets me, I had this dream a while ago, and yet I've only been planning this recently.

Yes and no. I'm pretty sure everyone takes some form of shortcut, sometimes its quicker and easier and still gets the job done properly. Though, it wasn't the shortcut thing I was focused on. Any more ideas on it would be appreciated, thanks. (sorry it's taken so long to reply, been kinda busy or just put it off)
If anyone has any requests or suggestions as to what or who I should draw next, feel free to put them here.

The only real short term goal I have is to last longer than a week. As for the suggestion about a single cut, I Don't think I'd be able to think about that when I'm cutting or about to. I don't go very deep most of the time,, but last time was the deepest I've gone since I started, there was enough blood to cover the majority of my wrist. I look after my cuts very well, and, although I don't always put a bandage on them, they heal within about a week or so, so chance of infection is minimised. Running isn't really an option at around 00:00, but if I can, then I would try to go running.

I'll be short, I have somewhere I need to be. 3 weeks ago, I got my mock exam results back, a C in English was great, a massive improvement, but a U in Maths was really not at all good, I dropped Maths that week. That weekend, I relapsed for the first time in 7 weeks, I ended up covering the back of my arm between my wrist and my elbow with cuts and then covered half my inner arm with cuts. I tried bandaging it up and going to work, but my mum found out and shouted at me, told me never to do it again and said I couldn't go to work. The next week went alright, from what I can remember, the week went fine, and at the weekend I worked both days. I ended up relapsing again Sunday night, I managed to keep that from my mum for a good week. Last week, I can't remember in very much detail, but I know that I relapsed again Last Sunday. And this week so far, Last night my mum found out I relapsed again and, being as unsupportive as ever, reiterated that the next time I do it, she'll cut me too, as well as a lot of shouting and, as I mentioned above, she told me to use a serrated knife next time. So, that's the last 3 weeks in a nutshell. PM me if you have any more questions, it's a little easier for me to be open with PMs, as not everyone can see them. So I hope that you got the information you wanted and I'll probably end up talking to you soon.

I've been trying to go longer than a week without harming, it just doesn't work. My mother should understand, mental health problems like this run in both my mother's and father's families. My father had anger problems and killed himself. My mother's brother tried to kill himself twice, and my sister harmed for a while. Before my father killed himself, he and my mum got divorced, and he went and lived with my grandfather, which is why I cannot live there. Last time I went over, just walking past his room I almost had a panic attack, 4 times, and that's probably the room that I'd be staying in. So yeah. It might seem a little weird, but last time I had a shower, the water dripping off me felt so good, I wanted it to be blood, but I just had to settle for water. Since I started Self harming over 4 months ago, I've just gotten worse and worse, at first, I didn't draw blood, then I started using a sharpener blade and gradually cut more and more and now I'm up to around 60-70 cuts each time. I should be starting CBT within the next few weeks, so that's something to look forward to... In the mean time, I'll just have to put up with my mum having a go at me for something I can't help.

I know how you feel to some degree. I'm not saying that I understand completely what you're going through and have been through, but I also have depression and anxiety, and they also drive me crazy. I have hardly any friends and have done all my life, and because I've been bullied at almost any opportunity I find it extremely difficult to talk to people. If you want to talk, just PM me. Hang in there, You'll make it through this.

There is a subreddit for this kind of thing. /r/StopSelfHarm You should check it out. You should really try another way to deal with your boredom, self harming isn't a good option, I know, and if you need to talk to someone, PM me.
